shots.text: Over the Kharum Terraces, Kaela brought Vholt's bird down with her own lance. She was there when he hit the ground.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The black thunderbird crashing on the terraces. Vholt crawling free. Kaela stands over him with her lance.

shots.text: Kaela... I went to the Rift because the Marshal asked me to. I'm sorry, girl. Finish it. Clean, the way I taught you.
shots.speaker: vholt
shots.art_note: Vholt's face, the grey light flickering out of his eyes as he looks up.

shots.text: Behind a fallen terrace we found what was left of the Canyon's shield-company. Gorrim Stonebeard was standing in front of them, with a stone door for a shield.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Gorrim Stonebeard, short and wide, a carved stone door as a shield, iron rings in his beard, standing in front of exhausted soldiers.

shots.text: One iron ring in my beard for every friend I've buried. Thirty-one. Let's not make it thirty-two.
shots.speaker: gorrim
shots.art_note: Gorrim hefting the door-shield onto his back. Joins as a hero.
